skill1: Activates when the last bullet hits the target. Affects the target.
skill2: Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects all enemies.
Attract: Taunt all enemies for 15.09 sec.
Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects self.

caveats: ⚑ skill1's enemy DEF ▼ 8.4% is TEAM-WIDE damage-relevant but has NO schema channel: StatKey defPct means the holder's own DEF, and the sim's boss DEF is an engine-level constant, not a buffable stat. It is therefore UNMODELED and the sim under-credits every ally's damage while it is up. Encoding it as damageTakenPct would be a fabricated conversion (DEF ▼ 8.4% ≠ Damage Taken ▲ 8.4%) and is refused.

⚑ Uptime arithmetic for that debuff (contingent on the datamined cadence): 120 ammo at SMG ~20 rounds/s effective = ~6.0s firing + 187 reload frames ≈ 3.1s = a ~9.1s magazine cycle against a 10s debuff, so the last-bullet debuff is effectively PERMANENT after the first magazine rather than intermittent.
skill1's enemy ATK ▼ 8.4% is defensive-only at scope lock (boss damage is unmodeled, allies are immortal) — no damage channel exists for it.

skill2's Attract/Taunt and the self Damage Taken ▼ 57.86% are both defensive-only at scope lock; the schema's damageTakenPct is a BOSS debuff (positive = boss takes more), not a self mitigation stat, so neither line maps to it.

⚑ The burst's 163.1% hit is authored noFb:true per the burst-cast FB-exemption rule (a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens); crit-eligibility is kit-silent and left to the engine default (no crit flag set).
The burst's 'Affects 10 enemy unit(s) with the highest final ATK' selector collapses to the single boss at scope lock; authored as target enemy.
The burst's ally DEF ▲ 12.93% is authored for kit completeness only — defPct is offensively inert in v1.
The burst's 'above 50% HP' activation gate is always satisfied at scope lock (no HP pool, nobody takes damage), so no block gate is authored; the verbatim line is recorded in unmodeled.burst.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Ludmilla (SMG/Water/Defender/Burst I) is a near-pure defensive kit: the only damage this override models is her burst's 163.1%-of-final-ATK instant hit, plus an ally DEF ▲ 12.93% / 10s carried for kit completeness (defPct is inert in v1). Both burst lines are keyed to burstCast (her own cast), and the burst hit is FB-exempt because a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens. Skill1 and skill2 are modeled as EMPTY: skill1's last-bullet enemy ATK ▼ is defensive, and its enemy DEF ▼ 8.4% — genuinely team-wide damage-relevant, at near-permanent uptime — has no schema channel because boss DEF is an engine constant rather than a buffable stat; skill2's Taunt and self Damage Taken ▼ 57.86% have no damage channel at scope lock. Those skipped lines are recorded verbatim in unmodeled and the DEF ▼ gap is flagged, not approximated.
